int_name: RISING SUN AVE & E ROOSEVELT BLVD

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, unmarked intersection with no visible crossing infrastructure or traffic control. Parked vehicles significantly obstruct sightlines at the corners, and the lack of defined pedestrian space creates a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks or signage indicate where pedestrians should cross the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles at the corner block the view between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten crossing distances and prevent parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve visibility.

result.summary: The environment is a wide multi-lane arterial with a significant median that acts as a pedestrian refuge. While a high-visibility crosswalk is present for the side street, the main thoroughfare presents a long crossing distance with high traffic exposure and car-centric design.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic on a wide arterial road, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right of image across the main roadway

hazards.name: Degraded refuge area
hazards.description: The median area intended for pedestrian refuge has cracked pavement and uneven surfaces, creating trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground center, around the light pole base

hazards.name: High traffic volume and speed
hazards.description: The multi-lane configuration and volume of vehicles suggest a high-speed, high-capacity environment hostile to pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings across the main thoroughfare to increase driver awareness of pedestrian crossing points.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Improvement
interventions.description: Repair and widen the median refuge island with accessible surfacing, tactile warnings, and better protection from traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The environment features a wide multi-lane roadway with a long, faded zebra-marked crosswalk that lacks a median refuge. Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for a significant distance without dedicated signals or protective infrastructure at this specific crossing point.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The pedestrian must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra stripes are significantly worn, reducing the visibility of the crossing to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the roadway in the foreground

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Refresh the crossing with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide, multi-lane roadway with signalized control but lacks robust pedestrian-specific infrastructure. Faded pavement markings and the absence of visible pedestrian signals or refuge islands create a high-exposure environment for people crossing.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk markings are extremely faded, making the designated crossing area unclear to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane road requires pedestrians to cross a significant distance without a median refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the width of the main thoroughfare

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic signal poles at the intersection
